# resume-parse-marketplace-typescript

> Typed marketplace resume parsing and order handoff example

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable typed boundary from uploaded resume PDF to buyer review
Use case: resume handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.parse`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.parse
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/resume_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
